data.content_ref: inline:Build a meta-level guarantee firewall: a polynomial-time verifier that takes any proposed extension of the grounded semantics (new artifact types, rules, or post-hoc computations) and checks whether it preserves the four commitments — fixed-point determinism, polynomial cost, reinstatement as derived, and committed-root validity — rejecting extensions that fail. This does not itself extend the semantics but makes future extension safe by construction, at the cost of a verification layer whose own correctness must be argued.
